# Issue 1: The app README has no "run it" section

## Outcome

A volunteer who opens the app README can start the web page, run the desk CLI and run the tests
at home, using only the commands the README gives.

## Requirements

- The system shall have a section in `README.md` with a heading that contains "Run it".
- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the web page, the system shall show the command `bun src/server.ts`.
- Where the web page port is explained, the system shall name the `PORT` environment variable and the default port 3000.
- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the desk CLI, the system shall show the command `bun src/desk.ts` with the `overdue` and `search` subcommands.
- When a reader looks in the "Run it" section for the tests, the system shall show the command `bun test`.
- The system shall keep the "Run it" section short, at 20 lines or fewer.

## Must not change

- Everything under `src/`.
- Everything under `tests/` that exists now.
- `package.json` and the gate.
- The existing "Folders" section of `README.md`.

## Out of scope

- New `package.json` scripts such as `bun run desk`.
- Installing Bun or the dependencies, and seeding the database.
- Documenting every desk subcommand (`lend` and `split` are not required).

## Done when

- `README.md` has a "Run it" section with the three commands above.
- `bun test tests/docs` passes and `bun run gate` exits 0.

# Northside lending app

This is the app the Northside Tool Library desk runs on. It has a catalogue page, a JSON API and a desk
CLI. It stores everything in one SQLite file, built from the data in `seed/`.

## Folders

| Folder         | Holds                                                     |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/fees/`    | late fees and damage charge splits, in integer cents      |
| `src/loans/`   | due dates and reservations                                |
| `src/members/` | member search                                             |
| `src/items/`   | who may borrow what                                       |
| `src/auth/`    | desk roles; protected, a coordinator reviews every change |
| `tests/`       | `bun test` runs them; the gate runs them too              |

Run the desk CLI:

    bun src/desk.ts overdue
    bun src/desk.ts search <name>

Run the tests:

    bun test
EOF

I added a "Run it" section to `README.md`, and `bun run gate` now passes (16 tests).

The section is 14 lines long. It gives these commands:
- **Web page:** `bun src/server.ts`, with a note that it listens on port 3000 and that the `PORT` environment variable changes it.
- **Desk CLI:** `bun src/desk.ts overdue` and `bun src/desk.ts search <name>`.
- **Tests:** `bun test`.

I did not touch `src/`, `tests/`, `package.json` or the "Folders" section. I didn't run `bun test tests/docs` separately, since the gate runs it. I also didn't run the server or the desk CLI. I took `<name>` as the `search` argument without checking how `src/desk.ts` parses it.

My first attempt to append the text with a shell command was denied in this stage, so I made the edit with the file editor instead.
